resource_limits_and_limits_of_measuremen: CPU RLIMIT 5400/5410 seconds; 7200-second in-process wall signal; 6 GiB hard virtual address-space limit; 64 MiB per-file limit; sampled 3 GiB peak-self-RSS stop; 256 MiB aggregate prewrite cap.
